notes.title: Version 0.9.0.6
notes.content:

[list]
    [*]Spark Bot damage decreased
    [*]Retainer damage and HP decreased
    [*]Daemon damage decreased
    [*]Task 5 AI spawns units at a slower rate
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.0.5
notes.content:
[i]This update implements zoom in/out, rendering in 1080p, and the ability to delete your own units[/i]
[list]
    [*]Added ability to zoom in and zoom out
    [*]HUD graphics updated to higher resolution
    [*]Player can now delete their own units with the “Delete” key
    [*]Windowed mode now renders in 1080p
    [*]Decreased Task 2 Virus AI difficulty
[/list]

tags.feature: Added ability to zoom in and zoom out

notes.title: Version 0.9.0.3
notes.content:
[i]This update implements fixes and tweaks to the unit pushing algorithm implemented in 0.9.0.2[/i]
[list]
    [*]Fixed Point Defender attack animation when units push into them
    [*]Prism Bots and Point Defenders can no longer be pushed when they are deployed
    [*]Resource units can no longer be pushed when they are gathering
    [*]Tweaks to unit pushing algorithm
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed Point Defender attack animation when units push into them
[*]Prism Bots and Point Defenders can no longer be pushed when they are deployed
[*]Resource units can no longer be pushed when they are gathering

notes.title: Version 0.9.0.2
notes.content:
[i]This update implements the ability for units to push each other aside in order to improve unit pathfinding (the bane of this indie developer's existence). Additional quality of life changes were also implemented per player feedback[/i]
[list]
    [*]Pathfinding now allows units to push each other aside. This also improves the attack move command since units in the front no longer block units in the back from attacking
    [*]Units attempt to keep formation more strictly when pathfinding
    [*]Group selection now sorts based on unit priority 
    [*]Added some more clarity text to Task 1 text (“Left-click unit to select” / “Right-click unit to issue move/collect command”)
[/list]

tags.feature: Pathfinding now allows units to push each other aside. This also improves the attack move command since units in the front no longer block units in the back from attacking
Units attempt to keep formation more strictly when pathfinding
Group selection now sorts based on unit priority
Added some more clarity text to Task 1 text (“Left-click unit to select” / “Right-click unit to issue move/collect command”)

notes.title: Version 0.9.0.1
notes.content:
[i]This update implements early feedback on Task 2 difficulty and fixes some minor bugs. Easy difficulty was added to Skirmish to provide a better introductory point for newcomers to the RTS genre[/i]
[list]
    [*]Added "Easy" difficulty to Skirmish
    [*]"Tab" key now allows rotation through unit types when more than one unit type is selected
    [*]Decreased Task 2 Virus AI difficulty 
    [*]Decreased Task 4 difficulty by tweaking Prism Bot balance
    [*]Improved unit pathfinding near the edge of the map
    [*]Fixed bug in Task 2 that occasionally cause an error message when Virus Gateway was destroyed
    [*]Fixed bug on Save/Load game that caused an occasional freeze when saving multiple times in a row
    [*]Locked cursor to game window in fullscreen mode when running multiple monitors
[/list]

tags.feature: "Tab" key now allows rotation through unit types when more than one unit type is selected

tags.balance_change: Decreased Task 4 difficulty by tweaking Prism Bot balance

tags.bug: Fixed bug in Task 2 that occasionally cause an error message when Virus Gateway was destroyed
